# United States - Life expectancy at birth

## Life expectancy improves in United States

In 2000 the life expectancy in United States increased to 76.64 years.

That year, the life expectancy for women was 79.3 years and for men 74.1 years. 

United States’s position worsened with respect to the 195 countries we publish said data, dropping from the 32th in 1999 to 33th in 2000.

If we look at the change in life expectancy in United States over the past several years, we find that it is higher than in 1999, when it was 76.58 years, which is the same of what happens compared to 1990, when it was 75.21 years.

In this page we show you the progression of the life expectancy in United States. You can see the life expectancy in other countries in life expectancy and see all the information about United States in American economy.
